_comment: SUBSET-SCOPED MANIFEST. This decision is 'ready' ONLY with respect to the three detectors implemented in P-003-S2 (LG-001/002/004); it is NOT a Phase-1 product verdict. The real §7 Phase-1 ceiling is 'ready_with_warnings' because LG-003/010/012/014/015 always carry pending external verification — those detectors arrive in later slices. Used here to prove blocker false-positives = 0 through the §9 harness.
